We see it in their temples, and we see it in their records. They trusted him, and their loyalty grew. He taxed merchants, controlled ships, and protected us. Their stability came from it. She might be rare, but if she ruled, she would use it the same way. They respected him, because he expanded it and it expanded him. You can see it: he gained power, and we gained stability.
